description: Save a position, an entry block or a rule under your wallet, tied to the contracts it depends on. Only your wallet can read it back. Up to 200 items per wallet, notes up to 500 characters; forget frees room.

item_id.description: your name for this item; saving the same item_id again replaces it (default pos:<chain>:<contract>)

note.description: up to 500 characters; no contact details, keys or secrets

saved_at_block.description: the entry block; later what_changed_since calls start here

chain.description: where a smart wallet lives (default base; ethereum is tried when base has no code)

message.description: optional: the exact text that was signed (the wallet line may be lowercase or checksummed)

nonce.description: used once; reuse within 10 minutes is refused

signature.description: 65-byte personal_sign signature (EOA) or a smart wallet's ERC-1271 signature

timestamp.description: unix seconds, within 600 s of the server clock

typed_data.description: true when the signature is EIP-712 PactaWalletAuth instead of personal_sign

wallet_session_token.description: the wallet_session_token from an earlier answer (valid 1 hour); use instead of wallet_auth

name: remember
title: Remember a Position
